name: Kaa-san Aishiteru ~Jinsei o Kaketa Hahaoya Kanraku Daisakusen~
original_name: 母さん愛してる～人生をかけた母親陥落大作戦～
source:
Haruki loves his mother Yuuko so much that he wants to marry her.

"You need to courage to be strong enough to come take me from your dad. Women like that kind of stuff, you know."

Just a friendly everyday conversation, or so she thought. But Haruki treated it like a promise, and as he grew, he waited for his chance.
His mother is the only woman for him -- and so begins his plan to throw it all away and take her for himself.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ259162.html/?unique_op=af&locale=en_US[/url]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
春树非常爱他的母亲优子，他想娶她。

“你需要有足够的勇气，足够坚强才能把我从你爸爸身边带走。你知道，女人喜欢这种东西。”

只是一次友好的日常谈话，至少她是这么想的。但春树把它当成一个承诺，随着他的成长，他等待着机会。
他的母亲是他唯一的女人，因此他开始计划抛弃一切，将她据为己有。
